title: ValueScope: Unveiling Implicit Norms and Values via Return Potential Model of Social Interactions

prompt.location: Figure 8 (Appendix E.3, few-shot binary pairwise labeling prompt)
prompt.note: Same few-shot prompt used for all Table 8 rows; temperature 0.2.

claim.metric: pairwise label accuracy vs human gold, Formality norm

notes: Live model is a secondary labeler compared against gpt-4-0613 (the labeler actually adopted). Re-execution needs the 100 gold-labeled comment pairs: only Reddit IDs are released, so text must be re-fetched and may be deleted; whether the 100 gold labels are in the repo is not stated. One soft gap on data, hence maybe.

resolution.plan: The 100 gold-labelled r/askmen vs r/askwomen comment pairs (Table 8 caption, Appendix E.1 footnote 11) are released as Reddit comment IDs only (Appendix: text withheld), so the texts must be re-fetched from Reddit by ID; the repository is the only place the pair list and gold labels can be. Then apply the Figure 8 few-shot pairwise prompt with gpt-4o-2024-05-13 at temperature 0.2 and score agreement with the gold labels per norm (Formality 0.80).
resolution.approximation: Deleted or edited comments shrink n; whether the 100 gold labels are in the repository is not stated in the paper; Reddit fetching is subject to API terms.
